summary: Cellectis S.A., a French clinical-stage biotech, filed a Form 6-K on May 20, 2026, solely to announce and provide notice of its Combined General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for June 25, 2026. The agenda includes routine items: approval of 2025 annual/consolidated financial statements, director renewals, share buyback authorization, share capital reduction via cancellation, and delegations to issue shares with preemptive rights waived for qualified investors or underwriters. No price, premium, or material transaction terms are stated. No board recommendation regarding a special situation is given; this is a standard annual general meeting notice under French corporate law, equivalent to a U.S. proxy statement for a routine meeting. As no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation is involved, this filing is classified as "None."
